decision_rule: QUESTION: does KV-cache quantization (homogeneous f16/q8_0/q4_0, -fa on) cost decode throughput on the MI210 at the v10 production kernel, at ~2k and ~32k prefill, Qwen3.8-27B-Q8_0? STOP RULE (measurement-sufficiency): the matrix is fixed by the producer (3 arms x 5 reps x 2 depths = 30 fresh llama-server launches); no interim efficacy peeking, interim looks are futility-only. Stop-on-answer when all 30 launches complete and the sidecar carries 12 rows; stop-on-futility on STOP/deadline, launch failure, missing residency or identity mismatch (producer fails closed and keeps partial evidence; an incomplete matrix voids the whole sidecar by design). RESULT FORMAT: out/run-<ts>/belief_measurements.jsonl, schema epyc.vidya.kv_quant_27b_v10_capture.v1, ingested by `cli.py ingest kv-quant-27b-v10-measurement` with refused=0. Binary: kernels/production/gpu (store; producer pins llama-server sha 2b49713f, hip f26a166b). Scope: bench-only; mixed K/V and -fa variation out of scope.
notes: Fresh prospective successor; exact original 30-launch design. Patched comparison ignores only ASLR load addresses; raw native receipts retained. Base research source 99301fa149af86a6f9743d2b0405c9234ba39586 plus reviewed patch; full prepared scripts closure verified before import. Requires no host-wide llama-server/KFD owner; precondition refuses rather than stopping another owner. The row reuses a pinned preparation-time model SHA-256 with path, file type, device, inode, size, mtime and ctime checks at execution. Smoke also requires the post-execution identity witness.
